tasks.task: Establish exclusion zone and position scissor lift at ground level
tasks.scope: Set exclusion barriers below roof edge, confirm car park access is clear, position scissor lift under transfer gate, verify platform stability and base bearing.
hazards: Crush injury — scissor lift hydraulic failure or uncontrolled descent
Struck by moving vehicle — car park access not fully cleared
Entrapment — worker contact with scissor lift mechanism during positioning
Loss of stability — uneven or contaminated car park floor bearing scissor lift load
tasks.dominant_hazard: Crush injury — scissor lift hydraulic failure or uncontrolled descent
controls: Check car park floor for oil, water, debris, or soft spots within scissor lift footprint and 1 m radius before positioning.
Position scissor lift only on level, solid, dry concrete. Do not place on gravel, asphalt, or suspect areas.
Establish exclusion zone: erect barriers (Class A fencing or tape) minimum 5 m perimeter below roof edge transfer point. Display warning signs.
Confirm car park access closed to all vehicles. Place 'Do Not Enter' signs at entry points. Verify no vehicle movement before lift operation.

Operate scissor lift controls only from ground controls while positioning. Confirm platform is fully lowered and locked before workers approach.
Brief all workers on exclusion zone boundaries and scissor lift hazards. No entry within exclusion zone during lift positioning or raising.
Position lift personnel only — maximum two workers spotting. All others remain outside exclusion zone.

🛑 STOP WORK if: car park floor shows settlement, collapse, or soft spots within scissor lift footprint.
🛑 STOP WORK if: vehicle access cannot be confirmed closed or vehicle enters exclusion zone.

tasks.task: Replace HVAC filters on four rooftop AHUs
tasks.scope: Access each AHU in sequence, remove spent filters, check filter housings for debris and damage, install replacement filters, confirm filter seals and frame fit.
tasks.hrcw_category: cl.2 — Construction work at height — risk of fall >2m

Laceration or abrasion — sharp filter frame edges or metal louvers

Remove spent filter slowly into closed bag — do not shake or release dust into air.
Check filter housing interior for loose debris, corrosion, or damage before installing new filter — photograph defects if visible.
Install replacement filter with gasket seal fully seated in frame — confirm frame clip engagement on all corners.

Position EWP to maintain 1.2 m minimum clearance from unprotected roof perimeter edge — do not overreach beyond platform edge.

🛑 STOP WORK if: HVAC system cannot be isolated or fan rotation is still present after isolation
🛑 STOP WORK if: worker loses balance, harness becomes detached, or edge protection is breached

Confirm HVAC system is restored to operational status — no restart until all workers have left roof.

Confirm all belt guards reinstalled and secured; all AHU isolation tags removed; roof area cleared of tools and equipment before worker transfers off roof.
